header.title: Schedule
header.venue: Beck Agricultural Center · 4550 US-52, West Lafayette, IN

events.title: Check-in & Breakfast
events.purpose: Networking and a relaxed start to the day; finalize poster setup.

events.title: Kickoff & Opening Remarks
speakers: Bernard Engel — Dean, College of Agriculture · Purdue University
events.purpose: Introduce the symposium theme “Growing with AI” and highlight the collaborative, student-led nature of the event.

events.title: Talk Session 1
events.topic: AI in Agriculture Today: From Field Data to Decision Making
events.purpose: Set the stage with field-informed insights and industry perspectives on how AI-enabled tools are reshaping production and agronomic decision-making.

subEvents.speaker: Navin Elango
subEvents.affiliation: Data Science Manager, Crop Protection · Corteva

subEvents.speaker: Elhan Ersoz
subEvents.affiliation: Clinical Assistant Professor, Digital Agriculture & Computational Biology · University of Illinois

events.title: Talk Session 2
events.topic: From Agricultural Challenges to AI-Driven Solutions
events.purpose: Highlight emerging research, innovations, and AI-driven discoveries with potential to shape scalable solutions.

subEvents.speaker: Julio Giordano
subEvents.affiliation: Professor of Dairy Cattle Biology & Management, Animal Science · Cornell University

events.title: Panel Discussion
events.topic: Bridging the Gap: Accelerating AI Adoption in Agriculture
speakers: Ignacio Ciampitti — Professor of Agronomy · Purdue University (Moderator)
Dan Kurdys — Managing Director, Strategic Growth · 9 North Group
Scott Fritz — President & Owner · Fritz Black Sand Farms
events.purpose: While innovation in digital agriculture is growing rapidly, adoption remains a major challenge. This panel explores how academia, industry, and growers can work together to accelerate the practical use of AI technologies.
topics: Training the next generation of agricultural technologists

events.title: Keynote: The Next Frontier of AI in Agriculture
speakers: William Aderholdt — Co-Founder & Executive Director · Grand Farm
events.purpose: A big-picture perspective on the future of AI in agriculture: emerging technologies, industry trends, and opportunities for innovation.
topics: The evolving role of artificial intelligence in food systems
Future opportunities for AI-driven agricultural solutions
How collaboration between academia, industry, and farmers can accelerate innovation

events.title: Hackathon Finals, Awards & Closing
events.purpose: Finalist teams present their projects, followed by recognition of the hackathon winners and closing remarks.

events.title: Poster Session & Networking
events.purpose: Explore student and faculty research, connect with industry representatives, and close out the day through demos and conversations across academia, industry, and emerging agtech.
